title: Praise of the wonderful letter
english: Well indeed for you, for your wonderful letter! It has brought upon us a rational spring, and in place of swallows it sounds something very musical. I am as one inspired by pleasure, admiring everything: the wording, the thought, the harmony, the writer.

title: Procopius likens himself to the Lydians
english: And I suddenly think I have become a Lydian, imitating the Lydians, who were devoted to Dionysus and observed spring only when Dionysus happened to be present among them.

title: Do not make me write out the grief of silence
english: But perhaps you will laugh at this, since sheer sophistry blooms all over it, and you might even call me a sophist as a reproach. Yet I am not able not to admire beautiful things. Even if you fall silent, best of men, we speak opposite things. But do not give me trouble, as I seek to present in writing the grief that comes from silence.
